author: TMRX
description: Configure a product from the Price List catalog, generate a customer quote, push parts to a Work Order, or start a Rental.
versionDescription: Agent commission is now grossed up: final price = price / (1 - commission %), e.g. 25% = price / 0.75, so the agent gets that share of the final price. Exempt lines (ISO, Startup, Calibration, Shipping) are unchanged and the 1.6% NET60 option stays a simple markup. Quotes already saved reprice with the new formula when reopened.
